lines: Stop there. Hands where I can see them.
You came over the river. Nobody comes over the river.
hesk.names.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Ferrum says we're dead. Who are you?
hesk.names.2.speaker: hesk

lines: Well? A name. Or the river back the way you came.
hesk.names.3.speaker: hesk

lines: Your name. Or the river.
hesk.names.4.speaker: hesk

lines: Wick. Say it again at the gate, so the yard hears.
hesk.names.5.speaker: hesk

lines: Wick.
I'm Hesk. Come in, Wick. Keep your blade low.
hesk.names.done.1.speaker: hesk

lines: The river is still there, Wick.
hesk.later.speaker: hesk

lines: The old waystone in the yard. You came for it, I think.
We hear the call too. Nights. The stone here stays dark.
hesk.relay.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Something's missing from it. Ask Dorrin. At the forge.
hesk.relay.2.speaker: hesk

lines: He'll look at his boots. Let him. Then ask again.
hesk.relay.3.speaker: hesk

lines: Dorrin. At the forge. Barley gate, then the waystone.
hesk.relay.4.speaker: hesk

lines: The stone blinks. Nights will be shorter. Good work.
hesk.relay.done.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Dorrin. At the forge. Barley gate, then the waystone.
hesk.relay.active.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Ferrum's dead are busy, Wick. Mind the geese.
hesk.after.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Keep your blade low, Wick.
hesk.meet.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Smoke on the wind, and a stranger on the track.
Walk back toward the smoke, Wick. See what is there.
hesk.path.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Go and look. Then tell me.
hesk.path.2.speaker: hesk

lines: The track, toward the smoke. Come back and tell me.
hesk.path.3.speaker: hesk

lines: Wolves at the goose pen. Every night, more of them.
hesk.fence.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Five of them. Drive them off, and we will talk.
hesk.fence.2.speaker: hesk

lines: The pen, past the fence. Five wolves.
hesk.fence.3.speaker: hesk

lines: The track, toward the smoke. Come back and tell me.
hesk.path.active.1.speaker: hesk

lines: The pen, past the fence. Five wolves.
hesk.fence.active.1.speaker: hesk

lines: You saw the smoke. Good. Now the wolves.
hesk.path.done.1.speaker: hesk

lines: The wolves are gone. I watched from the wall.
Come to the gate.
hesk.fence.done.1.speaker: hesk

lines: Read the names. Then come back to me.
hesk.board.2.speaker: hesk

lines: The board by the gate. Read it.
hesk.board.3.speaker: hesk

lines: The board by the gate. Read it.
That is who we are.
hesk.board.1.speaker: hesk

lines: The board by the gate. Read it, then come back to me.
hesk.board.active.1.speaker: hesk

lines: You read it. Now you know who we are. Good.
hesk.board.done.1.speaker: hesk
